title: From Electrical Characterization to Surface Contamination: The Role of Electrical-based Scanning Probe Microscopy Techniques
content: Scanning Probe Microscopy (SPM) has revolutionized the field of surface analysis by providing unprecedented spatial resolution and the ability to probe various surface properties at the nanoscale. Among the diverse SPM techniques, electrical scanning probe methods such as Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy, Scanning Spreading Resistance Microscopy, and Scanning Microwave Impedance Microscopy have emerged as powerful tools for investigating the electrical properties of materials through the detailed mapping of adsorbates, impurities, and other surface phenomena which can influence said properties. The focus of this presentation discusses the current state of these electrical SPM techniques, their applications, limitations, and future perspectives.
